name: synthetic-submit-envelope-error
description: SYNTHETIC: the call answers HTTP 200 with DashScope's error envelope (a non-empty top-level code). The intl docs never pin the HTTP status of every error class, so a 2xx is checked too: this is an upstream error dressed as success, settled as OUR synthesized 502 with providerHttpStatus 200 (design D7), zero-billed. Serves the video submit and the blocking image call alike.
